aboutDesc: Modern and simple software that automates your computer's power management.
aiModelNotDownloaded: AI model not downloaded. You can download it from Settings → AI Package.
aiPackageDesc: Language + voice model (~1.5 GB, one-time download). Install here if you skipped the wizard.
aiPrivacyNote: The AI Assistant runs fully on-device; your voice and commands never leave your computer.
aiTaskFailed: Task could not be set up.
apiBlockRemote: Block remote shutdown while user is active
apiLanNote: LAN access is only open to the IP/CIDR entries in the list. If the list is empty, only this computer can connect.
apiPortLine: Port: 18456 | Local server for n8n & CLI access.
apiQrNote: Scan with your phone camera (the key is visible on screen — be mindful of your surroundings).
apiTlsNote: LAN mode requires TLS. Certificate/key paths are read by the main process; private keys never leave this machine.
assistantSubtitle: Describe it in a sentence and let AI build the task. Example: "Shut down the computer when HandBrake finishes".
autonomyClassicDesc: Asks at every step and stops when the deadline is reached.
autonomyDesc: Approval behavior for AI tasks. Changes apply from the next task.
autonomyFullDesc: Executes, logs it, and offers undo.
cancelPinDesc: If set, cancelling a timer requires a PIN.

descNotifications: Turn on or off toast notifications for action feedback.
energyAccountDesc: Can be left blank — empty fields show "—" on cards.

errorEnableLanFirst: Enable LAN access and save first.

ossDescription: Power Pilot uses the following open source software. Please refer to the respective sections for their copyrights and license terms.
ossElectronDesc: Cross-platform desktop application framework. The runtime environment for Power Pilot.
ossElectronLogDesc: Simple logging module for Electron applications, used for local diagnostic logs.
ossFooterText: Full license texts are available in each package's repository.
ossIpaddrDesc: IP and CIDR parsing for the Local API allow-list.
ossMaterialSymbolsDesc: Icon font used for all UI icons. Bundled locally; no Google Fonts API requests.
ossNodeLlamaDesc: On-device LLM inference for the AI Assistant; no prompts leave the computer.
ossPsListDesc: Cross-platform process list used by the Smart Finish condition engine.
ossPublicSansDesc: A strong, neutral typeface for interfaces. Bundled locally; no Google Fonts API requests.
ossQrcodeDesc: Offline QR code generation for the Local API pairing screen.
ossSysteminformationDesc: Local hardware, battery, CPU and network metrics used for energy estimates.
ossTailwindDesc: CSS utility framework. Bundled locally with the application.
pinCancelTimerPrompt: Enter the PIN to cancel the timer.
pinPromptCancel: Enter the cancel PIN to continue.
priceNumberShort: Price must be a number (e.g. 3.24) or blank.
privacyBodyP1: This Privacy Policy explains how the Power Pilot application handles your personal data. At Vellium, we respect your privacy and attach great importance to transparency.
privacyChildrenP: Power Pilot does not knowingly collect data from individuals under 13 years of age.
privacyFooter: Last updated: June 2026 | Copyright © 2026 Vellium. All rights reserved.
privacyInternetP: Power Pilot does not require an internet connection for its core functions. The fonts and icon set (Google Fonts, Tailwind CSS CDN) used in the interface are loaded over the internet; these requests are subject to Google's own privacy policy.
privacyInternetP2: Power Pilot does not require an internet connection for its core features. The interface fonts, icons and CSS framework are bundled locally with the application; the interface never connects to a CDN. The network is only used when you download the AI package or send a webhook test.
privacyNoDataP: Power Pilot operates entirely locally (offline-first). No personal data, usage statistics, telemetry, or crash reports are collected, stored, or shared with third parties.
privacyStorageDesc: This data is only used to personalize your application according to your preferences and is never exported from your device.
privacyStorageP: The application only stores the following data locally on your device:
privacyThirdPartyP: The application uses the following open source libraries for its functionality. These libraries do not collect any data:
settingsVoiceDesc: Reads AI responses aloud (local system voice, offline).
sfMaxConditions: At most 3 conditions can be added.
sfSpecificTime: Specific time (optional — if selected, conditions are not monitored; it runs at that time)
sfSubtitle: Automate power management when your task finishes (render, download, idle, etc.).
sfTemplateLoaded: "{name}" loaded into the form. Adjust thresholds and save.
sfTemplateTimeApplied: "{name}" time applied to the form. Press Save.
statsSubtitle: Local savings statistics from Power Pilot.
subtitle: Smart Power Manager
suggestionDismissed: No suggestions for this topic for 30 days.
taskPinCancelPrompt: Enter the cancel PIN to cancel this task.
taskPinSnoozePrompt: Enter the cancel PIN to snooze this task.
tasksSubtitle: Manage all your scheduled and monitored automations.
templatesSubtitle: Ready scenarios you can customize with one click.
timerLimitDesc: For security and system stability, the maximum timer duration is limited to 24 days (2,073,600 seconds).
toastApiKeyAge: Your API key is 90 days old. Renewal is recommended.
toastConsoleTestSent: Test notification sent. Check the result at the recipient address.
toastDefaultsLoaded: Default settings loaded, don't forget to save.
toastEstimated: Estimate: ~{watt} W ({tier}, not a measurement). Press Save.
toastMeasuredFromBattery: Measured from battery: ~{watt} W (usage at that moment). Press Save.
toastNewApiKey: New API key created! Please copy it.
tplBackupStableDesc: Shuts down when the Downloads folder is unchanged for 5 minutes (download finished). Edit the template for a different folder.
tplBatteryHibernateDesc: Saves the session to disk and hibernates when the battery drops below 20%.
tplDownloadShutdownDesc: Safely shuts down the computer when network download speed drops below your threshold.
tplIdleSleepDesc: Puts the computer to sleep when the keyboard and mouse are unused for 15 minutes.
tplMeetingLockDesc: Automatically locks the screen when Zoom or Teams closes.
tplNightlySleepDesc: Puts the computer to sleep every night at 01:00.
tplPresentationLockDesc: Locks the screen when PowerPoint closes (presentation finished).
tplProcessLockDesc: Automatically locks the screen when Chrome closes. Edit the template for a different app.
tplRenderShutdownDesc: Shuts down when your render app (HandBrake, Premiere or Blender) closes or CPU usage drops below 10%.
tplSteamDownload: Shut Down When Steam Download Finishes
tplSteamDownloadDesc: Shuts down the computer when Steam is running and the network goes quiet (download finished).
trayBackgroundRunning: The app keeps running in the background. Active automations are being monitored.
trayPinProtected: Cancellation is PIN-protected. Please cancel from the window with the PIN.
warnStopPinPrompt: Enter the PIN to stop the warning.
webhookSubtitle: A notification is sent to your address when an event occurs. Secrets are written once and never shown again.
whenShutdown: When should we shut down your computer?
wizardAiDownloading: The AI package is downloading — you can wait here or skip and continue later.

wizardDataWarn: If you are on mobile data, mind your data allowance.
wizardDetectedInfo: {deviceClass} detected • ~{watt} W ({source}) — you can enter your own value below if you wish.
